_about: What a zone's doors are made of when their names don't say (src/doors.py): 'material' (cloth, glass, wood, oak, metal, iron, stone) sets how much force breaks them; 'arcane' doors are bound by old magic that no bash and no Break Door gets through (a key, a pick or a Block Door still works on them). 'doors' names single doorways, 'room:direction'.
